title: 第十章 山中第十一章 魔石
content_zh:
第三天，正午。
方圆和王紫璇站在那座山的山脚下，仰头望着眼前的庞然大物。
远看时只觉得山形奇特，近了才知道这座山有多么雄伟。山体拔地而起，方圆数十里，壁立千仞，陡峭得像是有人用一把巨刀从大地上生生劈出来的。山体呈深褐色，岩石坚硬如铁，上面寸草不生，光秃秃的像一块巨大的铁锭。
最诡异的是——周围明明是大片的森林和草地，动物种类繁多，但这座山方圆十里之内，没有任何活物。
没有鸟，没有虫，连蚂蚁都看不见。
寂静得像一座坟墓。
“就是这里了。”王紫璇拿出定星盘，指针疯狂地转了几圈后，直直地指向山体中央，然后“啪”的一声，指针断了。
断了？
王紫璇愣愣地看着手上只剩半截指针的定星盘，脸色发白。这个定星盘是她父亲留下的遗物，用了十几年都没出过问题，到了这里却直接报废。
“这个地方的磁场有问题。”方圆蹲下身，用手掌贴在地面上，闭上眼睛感知了片刻。
他的灵识刚一接触地面，就被一股无形的力量弹开了。那股力量浩瀚如海，古老如天，带着一种超越人类理解范畴的威严。
方圆睁开眼睛，眼中闪过一丝震惊。
前世身为玄帝，他见识过无数上古遗迹、远古战场、仙人洞府，能让他感到震惊的东西已经不多了。
但这座山给他的感觉，不一样。
那股力量的层次——远超他前世见过的任何东西。
“这座山不是自然形成的。”方圆站起身，目光凝重，“它是一件法宝。”
“法宝？”王紫璇愣住了，“你在开玩笑吧？这么大一座山，是法宝？”
“不是普通法宝，是上古至宝。”方圆的声音很低，“有人用无上法力，将一件法宝化作山形，镇压在这里。山体只是表象，真正的法宝藏在地下深处。”
王紫璇张了张嘴，想说什么，但最终什么都没说出来。
她不知道方圆说的是真是假，但有一点她可以肯定——这座山绝对不普通。天机阁查了十五年没查明白，十四个人进去没一个人出来，这本身就说明了问题。

“入口在哪？”方圆问。
王紫璇收起断掉的定星盘，从包袱里拿出天机阁的地图。地图上标注了三个可能的位置，都是天机阁派人探查后推测出来的，没有实际验证过。
“三个位置。”王紫璇指着地图，“山脚东侧有个天然洞穴，深不见底；山腰西侧有一处裂缝，据说能看到地下有光；山顶平地的正中央，有一个凹坑，像个陨石坑。”
方圆想了想：“先去山顶。”
从山脚到山顶没有路。两人手脚并用，在陡峭的岩石上攀爬。岩石很粗糙，摩擦力不错，但坡度太陡，有些地方几乎垂直，稍有不慎就会摔下去。
方圆在前，王紫璇在后，两人之间的距离不超过一丈。
攀爬到一半的时候，方圆突然停下。
“怎么了？”王紫璇问。
方圆没有说话，只是盯着面前的一块岩石。
岩石表面光滑如镜，和周围粗糙的岩石截然不同。上面刻着一些模糊的纹路，不是自然形成的，而是人工雕刻的。
方圆伸手摸了摸那些纹路，指尖传来一股冰冷的触感，像是摸到了寒冰。
“阵法纹路。”方圆说，“至少是上古时期的阵法，距今恐怕有万年以上。”
王紫璇凑过来看了一眼，什么都看不懂。她对阵法一窍不通，但方圆的语气让她觉得这不是小事。
“这座山上，到处都是这种东西。”方圆的手指沿着纹路滑动，“刻这些纹路的人，修为不在我——不在我见过的任何人之下。”
他差点说漏了嘴。“不在我之下”这四个字，前世他经常说，但这一世他见过的最高修为不过是方正阳的凝气境九重巅峰，说“不在我之下”毫无意义。
王紫璇没有注意到他的口误，她的注意力被另一件事吸引了。
不远处，一块岩石后面，有什么东西在反光。
“方圆，你看那边。”
方圆顺着她手指的方向看去，岩石后面隐约露出一个金属物件，在阳光下反射着微弱的光芒。
两人绕过去一看，是一把剑。

剑身没入岩石中，只露出剑柄和一截剑身。剑柄上镶着一颗已经黯淡无光的宝石，剑身上刻着两个字——“烈阳”。
content_en:
The third day, noon.
Fangyuan and Wang Zixuan stood at the foot of the mountain, looking up at the huge thing in front of them.
When you look at it from a distance, you just feel that the shape of the mountain is strange. When you get closer, you realize how majestic the mountain is. The mountain rises from the ground, with a radius of dozens of miles, and the walls stand thousands of feet high. It is so steep that it looks like someone has carved it out of the earth with a giant knife. The mountain is dark brown, and the rock is as hard as iron. There is no grass growing on it, and it is as bare as a huge iron ingot.
The strangest thing is that there are obviously large expanses of forest and grassland around, and there are many kinds of animals, but there is no living creature within ten miles of this mountain.
There were no birds, no insects, not even ants to be seen.
Silent as a tomb.
"This is it." Wang Zixuan took out the astrolabe. After a few crazy turns, the pointer pointed straight at the center of the mountain. Then with a "pop", the pointer broke.
Broken?
Wang Zixuan stared blankly at the astrolabe with only half of the pointer left in her hand, her face turning pale. This astrolabe was a relic left by her father. It had been used for more than ten years without any problems, but it was immediately scrapped when it arrived here.
"There is something wrong with the magnetic field in this place." Fangyuan squatted down, put his palms on the ground, closed his eyes and felt for a moment.
As soon as his spiritual consciousness touched the ground, it was bounced away by an invisible force. That power is as vast as the sea, as ancient as the sky, and carries a majesty beyond the scope of human understanding.
Fangyuan opened her eyes, a flash of shock flashed in her eyes.
As Emperor Xuan in his previous life, he had seen countless ancient ruins, ancient battlefields, and immortal caves. There were not many things that could shock him.
But this mountain gave him a different feeling.
The level of that power - far beyond anything he had ever seen in his previous life.
"This mountain is not naturally formed." Fangyuan stood up with a solemn gaze, "It is a magic weapon."
"Magic weapon?" Wang Zixuan was stunned, "Are you kidding me? Such a big mountain is a magic weapon?"
"It's not an ordinary magic weapon, it's an ancient treasure." Fangyuan's voice was very low. "Someone used supreme magic power to turn a magic weapon into a mountain shape and suppress it here. The mountain is just an appearance, and the real magic weapon is hidden deep underground."
Wang Zixuan opened her mouth and wanted to say something, but in the end nothing came out.
She didn't know whether what Fangyuan said was true or not, but she was certain of one thing - this mountain was definitely not ordinary. Tianji Pavilion has been investigating for fifteen years but has not been able to find out. Fourteen people went in and no one came out. This in itself explains the problem.
"Where is the entrance?" Fangyuan asked.
Wang Zixuan put away the broken astrolabe and took out the map of Tianji Pavilion from the bag. There are three possible locations marked on the map, all of which were speculated after Tianji Pavilion sent people to investigate and have not been verified in practice.
"Three locations." Wang Zixuan pointed to the map, "There is a natural cave on the east side of the foot of the mountain, which is bottomless; there is a crack on the west side of the mountainside, and it is said that light can be seen underground; and in the center of the flat land on the top of the mountain, there is a depression, like a meteorite crater."
Fangyuan thought for a while: "Go to the top of the mountain first."
There is no road from the foot of the mountain to the top. The two used their hands and feet to climb up the steep rocks. The rock is very rough and has good friction, but the slope is too steep and almost vertical in some places. If you are not careful, you will fall.
Fangyuan is in front, Wang Zixuan is behind, and the distance between them is no more than ten feet.
Halfway through the climb, Fangyuan suddenly stopped.
"What's wrong?" Wang Zixuan asked.
Fangyuan said nothing, just stared at a rock in front of him.
The surface of the rock is as smooth as a mirror, which is completely different from the rough rocks around it. There are some vague lines engraved on it, which are not naturally formed but artificially carved.
Fang Yuan reached out and touched the lines, and felt a cold touch on his fingertips, as if he had touched ice.
"The pattern of the formation." Fangyuan said, "At least the formation is from ancient times, probably more than ten thousand years ago."
Wang Zixuan came over and took a look, but couldn't understand anything. sheShe didn't know anything about battle tactics, but Fangyuan's tone made her feel that this was no small matter.
"This mountain is full of things like this." Fang Yuan slid his fingers along the lines, "The person who carved these lines is not as good as me - not as good as anyone I have ever seen."
He almost let it slip. He often said the words "not under me" in his previous life, but the highest cultivation level he had ever seen in this life was only Fang Zhengyang's ninth level peak of Qi Condensation Realm, so saying "not under me" was meaningless.
Wang Zixuan didn't notice his slip of the tongue. Her attention was attracted by another thing.
Not far away, behind a rock, something was reflecting light.
"Fang Yuan, look over there."
Fangyuan looked in the direction of her finger, and saw a metal object vaguely exposed behind the rock, reflecting faint light in the sunlight.
The two of them walked around and saw that it was a sword.
The sword was submerged in the rock, leaving only the hilt and a section of the sword exposed. The hilt of the sword is inlaid with a dull gem, and two words are engraved on the sword - "Fire Sun".
